item.title: Germany plans three trade missions to Qatar in 2027
item.description:
Germany’s Federal Ministry for Economic Affairs and Energy said on Sunday it plans to send three trade missions to Qatar in 2027, following the Amir’s state visit to Germany on 20 and 21 November. One mission will focus on energy-efficient construction and smart-city solutions. Berlin welcomed Qatari investments in Germany exceeding €25bn, while the Qatar Investment Authority plans another €15bn over five years. The Qatari Businessmen Association called for turning understandings into concrete industrial and investment projects.
Sources: Gulf Times (QNA) https://www.gulf-times.com/article/738807/international/germany-plans-three-trade-missions-to-qatar-in-2027 · Al Raya (QNA) https://www.raya.com/2026/11/22/خطط-لإيفاد-3-بعثات-اقتصادية-إلى-الدوحة-العام-المقبل · Al Sharq (QNA) https://al-sharq.com/article/23/11/2026/الشيخ-خالد-بن-ثاني-يؤكد-أهمية-التعاون-مع-الشركات-الألمانية-وتوطين-الصناعات-والتكنولوجيا-في-قطر · The Peninsula https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/22/11/2026/qba-participates-in-the-qatari-german-economic-meeting

item.title: Art Basel Qatar 2027 unveils public programme with 81 galleries
item.description:
Art Basel Qatar 2027 on Sunday unveiled an expanded public programme for its second edition, set for 28 to 30 January 2027 in Msheireb Downtown Doha. The fair brings 81 galleries from 37 countries, 16 of them first-time participants, showing work by 79 artists. The programme centres on two monumental site-specific commissions at Barahat Msheireb and the Doha Design District Atrium, by Buro Koray Duman with Bidoun and Emirati artist Farah Al Qasimi.
Sources: Qatar News Agency (QNA) https://qna.org.qa/en/News-Area/News/2026-11/23/art-basel-qatar-2027-unveils-2nd-edition-of-reimagined-public-program · Al Sharq (QNA) https://al-sharq.com/article/22/11/2026/آرت-بازل-قطر-2027-يكشف-عن-برنامج-عام-موسع-بمشاركة-فنانين-ومؤسسات-دولية

item.title: Media City Qatar agrees deal for Fadel Shaker biopic
item.description:
The Film Committee at Media City Qatar has reached an agreement in principle with Lebanese singer Fadel Shaker to acquire the rights to his life story for a feature film. The deal was announced as the second Doha Film Makers Meeting closed after three days, drawing about 450 professionals from 38 countries across 20 sessions. Discussions covered film financing and distribution and Qatar’s film and television production incentive programme.
Sources: The Peninsula https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/22/11/2026/media-city-qatar-to-bring-lebanese-singer-fadel-shakers-life-story-to-big-screen · Al Raya (QNA) https://www.raya.com/2026/11/22/ملتقى-الدوحة-لصناع-الأفلام-2026-يختتم-فعالياته-بالإعلان-عن-إنتاجات-سينمائية-جديدة-وشراكات-عالمية · Al Sharq (QNA) https://al-sharq.com/article/22/11/2026/ملتقى-الدوحة-لصناع-الأفلام-2026-يختتم-فعالياته-بالإعلان-عن-إنتاجات-سينمائية-جديدة-وشراكات-عالمية

item.title: Qatar Chamber and Katara academy sign training MoU
item.description:
Qatar Chamber and Katara International Academy signed a memorandum of understanding on Sunday to boost cooperation in training and professional development for private-sector employees. It was signed by Qatar Chamber Acting General Manager Ali Bu Sharbak Al Mansori and Academy Director General Dr Hassan Abdullah Al Mannai. The deal allows the two sides to organise specialised training programmes matched to private-sector needs and labour-market requirements.
Sources: Qatar Tribune https://www.qatar-tribune.com/article/265798/latest-news/qatar-chamber-katara-intl-academy-sign-mou-to-boost-cooperation-in-training-and-professional-development · Al Sharq (QNA) https://al-sharq.com/article/22/11/2026/غرفة-قطر-وأكاديمية-كتارا-توقعان-مذكرة-تفاهم-لتعزيز-التعاون-في-مجالات-التدريب

item.title: Qatar U-17 need win over Greece on Wednesday
item.description:
Qatar’s U-17 side need to beat Greece on the evening of Wednesday 25 November in the final Group A round of the FIFA U-17 World Cup to boost their chances of reaching the round of 32. Qatar sit third on 3 points after a 2-0 defeat to Egypt, while Greece have already qualified. Kick-off is at 5:30pm Doha time.
Sources: Al Raya https://www.raya.com/2026/11/23/العنابي-يعلق-مصيره-بنقاط-اليوناني · Qatar Tribune https://www.qatar-tribune.com/article/265810/latest-news/egypt-beat-qatar-2-0-at-fifa-u-17-world-cup

item.title: Two tankers on fire east of the Strait of Hormuz
item.description:
Iran’s navy said on Sunday that two supertankers hit naval mines and caught fire after entering a “restricted area” east of the Strait of Hormuz, according to the Fars news agency. The UK Maritime Trade Operations agency reported an incident between a tanker and “military forces” in the Gulf of Oman near Chabahar, without details. It was unclear whether the incidents were linked. Iran had threatened a military response to any US attempt to stop its tankers.
Sources: Middle East Eye https://www.middleeasteye.net/live-blog/live-blog-update/two-supertankers-hit-mines-near-hormuz-iranian-navy-says · Al Jazeera (live blog) https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2026/11/22/iran-war-live-tankers-set-ablaze-in-hormuz-as-irgc-warns-of-unrest-threat · Euronews https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/22/tanker-incident-involving-military-forces-reported-in-strait-of-hormuz

item.title: GCC railway passes 55% completion
item.description:
The Gulf Cooperation Council railway is 55.92% complete, according to the latest monitoring data for 2026, and is targeted to start operating by the end of 2030. The roughly 1,768km line links all six member states. For Qatar, it opens neighbouring markets and strengthens Hamad Port and the Umm Al Houl Free Zone. Lulu Group director Mohammed Althaf said rail links would reshape regional supply chains and retail.
Sources: Gulf Times (QNA) https://www.gulf-times.com/article/738805/qatar/gcc-railway-project-crosses-the-halfway-mark-eyes-2030-launch · The Peninsula (QNA) https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/22/11/2026/gcc-railway-project-a-strategic-catalyst-to-turbocharge-economic-integration-regional-connectivity · Qatar Tribune https://www.qatar-tribune.com/article/265893/business/gcc-railway-set-to-transform-regional-trade-and-supply-chains-says-althaf

item.title: UAE gold shops see busiest buying of the year
item.description:
UAE gold markets saw their busiest trading of the year on Sunday after prices fell to their lowest level in 2026. 24-carat gold closed at Dh426.5 per gram and 22-carat at Dh395, according to Dubai Jewellery Group. Traders said sales rose more than 25% in two days. The gram has lost Dh64 in two weeks, while gold closed the week at $3,525 an ounce.
Sources: Emarat Alyoum https://www.emaratalyoum.com/business/local/2026-11-23-1.2105430 · Khaleej Times https://www.khaleejtimes.com/business/dubai-gold-price-below-dh450-is-it-time-to-buy-or-will-it-fall-further

item.title: Kuwait launches Tawtheeq online power-of-attorney platform
item.description:
Kuwaiti Justice Minister Nasser Al-Sumait on Sunday launched the first phase of Tawtheeq, a platform that lets citizens and residents issue, register, verify and revoke powers of attorney online. It covers nine categories without a visit to the Notarization Department. Some documents, including those authorising ownership transfers, require a video call with a notary. The platform links the ministry with other government agencies, and two further phases will follow.
Sources: Kuwait Times (KUNA) https://kuwaittimes.com/article/54173/kuwait/ministry-introduces-online-issuance-and-revocation-of-powers-of-attorney/ · Arab Times https://www.arabtimesonline.com/news/kuwait-gives-power-of-attorney-system-a-digital-makeover/

item.title: Kuwait and UAE bust fraud ring using local numbers
item.description:
Kuwait’s Interior Ministry said on Sunday it had arrested a suspect linked to a cross-border fraud gang, in coordination with UAE security authorities. Operating from abroad, the gang used devices running multiple SIM cards so calls appeared to come from local numbers. A shipment of telecoms equipment and 75 SIM cards, five of them from UAE operators, was seized. The Aman operations room has received 3,394 fraud reports this year, with losses of about KD1 million.
Sources: Gulf News https://gulfnews.com/world/gulf/kuwait/kuwait-arrests-suspect-linked-to-cross-border-fraud-gang-in-uae-security-cooperation-1.500757318 · Arab Times https://www.arabtimesonline.com/news/kuwait-uae-track-fraud-network-using-fake-local-numbers-75-sim-cards-seized/

item.title: Dollar steady at EGP 54.47 as Monday trading opens
item.description:
The dollar held steady in Egyptian banks as trading opened on Monday, after rising at least 62 piastres on Sunday. The National Bank of Egypt and Banque Misr quoted EGP 54.37 buying and EGP 54.47 selling, and the Central Bank EGP 54.36 and EGP 54.50. The highest rate was EGP 54.53 selling at Al Ahli Bank of Kuwait.
Sources: Youm7 https://www.youm7.com/story/2026/11/23/x/7628599 · Elbalad News https://www.elbalad.news/7190767

item.title: Egypt gold steady with 21-carat near EGP 5,540
item.description:
Gold prices in Egypt held at their weekend levels as trading opened on Monday, after rising on Sunday on local demand. 21-carat gold stood at about EGP 5,540 per gram according to Youm7, and EGP 5,525 selling according to Elbalad, with 24-carat near EGP 6,321. The gold pound was about EGP 44,180. The ounce ended last week near $3,538.
Sources: Youm7 https://www.youm7.com/story/2026/11/23/x/7628581 · Elbalad News https://www.elbalad.news/7190601

item.title: Egypt eyes refining Iraqi crude ahead of PM visit
item.description:
Egyptian Petroleum Minister Karim Badawi discussed refining Iraqi crude at Egyptian refineries with Iraqi Ambassador Qahtan Taha Khalaf, ahead of a visit to Cairo by Iraqi Prime Minister Ali Faleh Al-Zaidi on Monday. They reviewed the work of ENPPI, Sun Misr and Petromint in Iraq and the Egyptian General Petroleum Corporation’s role in exploration and production there. The ambassador said Al-Zaidi puts cooperation with Egypt at the top of his Arab priorities.
Sources: Elbalad News https://www.elbalad.news/7190893 · Shorouk News https://www.shorouknews.com/news/view.aspx?cdate=23112026&id=470fb26c-2bbc-4b6b-b8da-19b14da3c6c9

item.title: Al Ahly host Pyramids as Zamalek visit El Gouna
item.description:
Two headline matches take place on Monday in round nine of the Egyptian Premier League. Zamalek, third on 19 points, visit bottom side El Gouna, on 3 points, at 5pm Cairo time at Khaled Bishara Stadium. Al Ahly host Pyramids at 8pm at Cairo International Stadium, with seven Moroccan and Algerian players across the two squads.
Sources: Youm7 https://www.youm7.com/story/2026/11/23/x/7625878 · Cairo 24 https://www.cairo24.com/2534178 · Youm7 https://www.youm7.com/story/2026/11/22/x/7628652 · Youm7 https://www.youm7.com/story/2026/11/23/x/7628461

item.title: Egypt warns of dense fog until 10am
item.description:
Egypt’s Meteorological Authority warned of dense fog on Monday from 4am to 10am on roads to northern Egypt, Greater Cairo, the Canal cities, central Sinai and northern Upper Egypt. Visibility may drop below 1,000 metres. The authority expects a slight fall in temperatures and chances of light rain on the northern coast continuing until Wednesday.
Sources: Masrawy https://www.masrawy.com/news/news_egypt/details/2026/11/23/3082995 · Elbalad News https://www.elbalad.news/7190870

item.title: Democrats win largest House majority since 1992
item.description:
Democrats have won at least 258 seats in the US House of Representatives, their largest majority since 1992, after a North Carolina race was called on Sunday. Democrat Chuck Hubbard defeated Republican Representative Virginia Foxx by 330 votes after a recount. Four races remain undecided. Democrats will also hold 56 Senate seats when Congress is sworn in on 3 January.
Sources: Al Jazeera (AP) https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/22/democrats-win-largest-house-majority-since-1992-with-north-carolina-seat · Gulf News https://gulfnews.com/world/americas/us-democrats-secure-258-house-seats-largest-majority-in-three-decades-1.500757394

item.title: KOSPI opens 2.77% lower after Wall Street losses
item.description:
South Korea’s KOSPI opened Monday down 2.77% at 4,734.90, tracking Wall Street losses and concerns over the AI sector. Losses were limited by government emergency measures, including a market stabilisation fund of about 10 trillion won, and buying by foreign and institutional investors. The index fell 5.21% on Friday to below 5,000. Tokyo is closed for a public holiday, Newsquawk said.
Sources: Seoul Economic Daily https://en.sedaily.com/market/2026/11/23/kospi-opens-down-28-percent-as-emergency-measures-blunt · Korea JoongAng Daily (Yonhap) https://www.koreajoongangdaily.com/business/kospi-opens-sharply-lower-amid-ai-fears/12985333 · Newsquawk https://www.newsquawk.com/headlines/newsquawk-daily-asia-pac-opening-news---23rd-november-2026

item.title: Libya loses 350,000 bpd after Sharara line closure
item.description:
Libya’s National Oil Corporation said on Monday an outlaw group had closed a valve on the crude pipeline from the Sharara field, costing about 350,000 barrels per day. Total losses reach about 365,000 bpd with the Hamada line still shut. The UN Support Mission in Libya called for an immediate, independent inquiry into the attacks on Benghazi port.
Sources: Masrawy (Reuters) https://www.masrawy.com/news/news_publicaffairs/details/2026/11/23/3082990 · Elbalad News https://www.elbalad.news/7190903 · Masrawy https://www.masrawy.com/news/news_publicaffairs/details/2026/11/23/3082989 · Elbalad News https://www.elbalad.news/7190910

item.title: Trump says Iran fired most missiles and drones in a year
item.description:
US President Donald Trump said Iran launched more missiles and drones last week than at any time in over a year, adding that all were shot down without damage. He told Fox News that talks with Tehran were making no progress and threatened to sink any Iranian vessel trying to break the naval blockade. Brent fell below $92 a barrel on Monday morning.
Sources: Masrawy https://www.masrawy.com/news/news_publicaffairs/details/2026/11/23/3082984 · Elbalad News https://www.elbalad.news/7190876 · SBS News https://news.sbs.co.kr/english/article.do?news_id=N1008858756

item.title: Likud and Yashar end unity talks without deal
item.description:
Talks between Benjamin Netanyahu’s Likud and Gadi Eisenkot’s Yashar ended on Sunday without agreement on an Israeli unity government. Each side insists on its leader as prime minister, and Yashar demands the exclusion of Itamar Ben-Gvir. The parties agreed to meet again without setting a date. Eisenkot has until 6 December to form a government, with a possible 14-day extension.
Sources: Al Jazeera https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/22/netanyahus-likud-eisenkots-yashar-end-coalition-talks-without-deal · Elbalad News https://www.elbalad.news/7190902 · Oman Observer (AFP) https://www.omanobserver.om/article/1200050/world/region/netanyahu-and-eisenkot-parties-resume-talks-to-form-israel-government
